meta.name: microservices-patterns
meta.description: Design microservices architectures with service boundaries, event-driven communication, and resilience patterns. Use when building distributed systems, decomposing monoliths, or implementing microservices.

copy.tagline: 设计微服务架构与交互模式
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正需要设计微服务架构或拆分已有系统。
copy.tagline_en: Design microservices with patterns for boundaries, events, resilience.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're designing microservices or breaking up a monolith.

howto.what: 帮你做微服务架构设计:拆分服务边界、选服务间通信方式、规划每服务独立数据库与 Saga 事务,以及熔断、重试、隔离舱等容错模式。
howto.when: 拆分单体应用、设计服务边界与契约,或构建分布式系统、实现微服务时触发。

say.text: 帮我把订单模块按业务能力拆成微服务,并给出服务边界
say.note: 输出拆分方式与边界划分

say.text: 订单和支付服务用事件通信,给我 Saga 补偿方案
say.note: 得到事件驱动与补偿示例

say.text: 给这个服务调用加上熔断和指数退避重试
say.note: 得到容错模式配置示例

howto.what_en: Helps you design microservices: split service boundaries, choose sync or async inter-service communication, plan a database per service with Saga transactions, plus circuit breaker, retry and bulkhead resilience patterns.
howto.when_en: Triggers when decomposing a monolith, designing service boundaries and contracts, or building and implementing distributed microservices.

say_en.text: Split my order module into microservices by business capability
Show a Saga compensation flow for order and payment services using events
